Senior Product Manager, Payments

Acme Pay is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own checkout and payouts.

What you will do
- Own the payouts roadmap with engineering and finance.
- Run discovery with merchants and turn findings into specs.

What we look for
- 5+ years of product management, including B2B or payments.
- Comfortable writing SQL for your own analysis.

Location: Remote (US time zones).
